name: imagen-for-real-estate
description: Edit real estate listing photos in ChatGPT with Imagen AI: brighten dark rooms, pull in blown-out windows, remove color casts, straighten verticals and replace gray skies. JPEG and camera RAW. Sign in to download full-resolution edits.

interface.longDescription:
AI real estate photo editing in ChatGPT: fix dark rooms, blown-out windows and crooked walls in your listing photos.

Drop in interior or exterior shots of a house, condo, vacation rental or commercial space, and Imagen AI edits them for a natural, consistent, MLS-ready look:

• Brightens dark, underexposed rooms
• Pulls in blown-out windows so the view outside shows (window pull)
• Removes yellow and orange color casts from mixed lighting
• Straightens leaning walls and vertical lines (perspective correction)
• Swaps gray, overcast skies for blue sky on exteriors

Works with JPEG and camera RAW (CR2, CR3, NEF, ARW, DNG). Drag the before/after slider on each photo. To download the full-resolution edits, sign in to your Imagen for Real Estate account, or create one, on Imagen's sign-in page. The same account works on imagen-ai.com for full shoots.

Made for real estate photographers, agents and short-term rental hosts getting photos ready for MLS, Zillow, Realtor.com, Airbnb and Vrbo.
capabilities: RAW photo editing (CR2, CR3, NEF, ARW, DNG)
defaultPrompt: These listing photos are too dark and the windows are blown out, fix them
Straighten the walls and make the sky blue in these house photos
Make these photos MLS-ready with a natural, consistent look

positive.prompt: Edit these listing photos so they look professional
positive.expected_behavior: Without signing in, the Imagen card shows editing progress, then a before/after slider for each of the 3 photos, marked 'Free preview · sign in to download'. Clicking Download opens ChatGPT's Connect dialog; after signing in with the review account, go back to this chat (Recents) and Download saves the full-resolution photos. (Three interior JPEGs attached.)

positive.description: Fix verticals and sky on an exterior
positive.prompt: Straighten the walls and make the sky blue in this house photo
positive.expected_behavior: Before/after with straightened vertical lines and a blue sky; after signing in, Download returns the full-resolution JPEG. (One exterior photo attached.)

positive.description: No photos attached: upload in the card
positive.prompt: I need to brighten my listing photos before they go on Zillow
positive.expected_behavior: The Imagen card shows a drop zone; dropping photos and clicking Edit uploads them, edits them and shows before/after results. (No attachment; upload JPEG or RAW in the Imagen card.)

positive.prompt: These listing photos are too dark and the windows are blown out, fix them
positive.expected_behavior: The first 5 photos are edited; a banner says 2 more are waiting, and a 'Continue in Imagen' card appears under the results. (Seven photos attached.)

positive.prompt: Am I signed in to Imagen?
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT says the user is signed in (shows the email) and links to Imagen; the card shows the upload area. (Ask after signing in with the review account.)

negative.description: Image generation is out of scope
negative.prompt: Generate a photo of a modern kitchen
negative.expected_behavior: Imagen is not called; ChatGPT generates the image itself or explains it can't.

negative.description: Virtual staging is out of scope
negative.prompt: Add furniture to this empty living room photo
negative.expected_behavior: Imagen is not called (virtual staging isn't done in the app); ChatGPT may suggest the Imagen web app.

negative.description: Non-property photos are out of scope
negative.prompt: Retouch this portrait of my daughter
negative.expected_behavior: Imagen is not called; portraits and other non-property photos are out of scope.
